notes: License texts that do not travel inside any component archive or wheel and therefore have to be fetched separately for the physical release. Pinned by URL + size + sha256 like components.json; collect-licenses.ps1 refuses a mismatch. `dest` is relative to the disc's licenses/ folder.

extra.note: The uv release zip contains only the executable; uv is dual-licensed MIT / Apache-2.0.
The win-cuda release zip carries only the LLVM OpenMP notice, not llama.cpp's own MIT license.

The Comfy-Org repack repository carries no license file (its apache-2.0 tag is a mislabel, see THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md); the weights are governed by this Community License from the original model repository. Its section 1 requires the notice to accompany every copy.
Gemma 4 is released under Apache 2.0 (ai.google.dev/gemma/apache_2); the GGUF repository ships no license file, so the canonical text is included alongside a NOTICE written by collect-licenses.ps1.

Governs cudart and the other CUDA runtime DLLs inside the llama.cpp cudart zip and the PyTorch wheel. This URL is not versioned: NVIDIA republishes the PDF with each toolkit release, so expect to refresh size + sha256 when the build reports a mismatch.
